set.body:
G4 is closed; do not repeat project lifecycle implementation. Complete the six named residuals below on bounded branches, preserving their existing acceptance.
- bd-01M5P3EJ0NC4PXQH0CKQY4WHV2: Studio: preserve map and plot readability at the supported minimum window size
- bd-01M5NWGK8E9SW3JRKJ69QHMG9B: Results: reconcile complete Tab-order derivation with live plot/table contents
- bd-01M44PBGT3KAFQ160QTEV3G3HK: Project store: retention of parts from earlier saves
- bd-01M3GA04MZM3K946VJBBQNSMHH: Studio FX harness: consume OS pointer events not fired by the test robot, suite-wide
- bd-01M3GESYRNVGBHGZJQZQ15AVKA: Deterministic render-thread fault for the FX render-failure capture test
- bd-01M3HHR5QV9W9SS9AMM1RR1SM0: Make the IPv6 fork-handshake workaround the default for local gates
Exit: all six closed with source-bound evidence; source changes batch-qualified. This group absorbs the unfinished operational work from old wave0 and wave3. Protocol field retirement is deferred to a breaking protocol revision; it is not a 1.0 feature.
set.title: 1.0 A: application hardening and final usability fixes
